Maneuvering

Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur

The force applied to a tow or mooring line connecting a tug to a vessel, monitored to ensure safe and effective manoeuvring or holding.

Quick answer: The force applied to a tow or mooring line connecting a tug to a vessel, monitored to ensure safe and effective manoeuvring or holding.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur?

In this glossary, Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur refers to: The force applied to a tow or mooring line connecting a tug to a vessel, monitored to ensure safe and effective manoeuvring or holding.

How is Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Surveillez la tension de la remorque du remorqueur en permanence pendant l’accostage pour éviter une rupture soudaine de la ligne ou la dérive du navire."

Why does Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur matter in maritime?

Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur matters because it supports clear communication in Maneuvering contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur?

Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

The force applied to a tow or mooring line connecting a tug to a vessel, monitored to ensure safe and effective manoeuvring or holding.

Operational example

Monitor tug line tension at all times during berthing to prevent sudden line failure or vessel drift.

Localized term

Tension de la Remorque du Remorqueur

Localized example

Surveillez la tension de la remorque du remorqueur en permanence pendant l’accostage pour éviter une rupture soudaine de la ligne ou la dérive du navire.
